environment.description: Identical Quarkus 3.2 native deployment on AWS Lambda. PostgreSQL 15 RDS with same RLS policy for tenant isolation. CloudFront distribution in front of API Gateway with a response headers policy (ID: managed-policy-67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d5-5b4eb9f0518d) that injects Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'none'; style-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self' on ALL origin responses. Additionally, the API Gateway stage has a request validator requiring application/json content-type on POST endpoints, and the CloudFront distribution has a Lambda@Edge viewer-response function (arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789:function:security-headers-v3) that strips any existing CSP and re-applies the strict policy, preventing origin override. The RLS policy ensures stored XSS payloads from tenant A cannot be retrieved by tenant B even if injected.

config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON notes FOR ALL USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))
config.cloudfront_response_headers_policy: Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'none'; style-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'
config.lambda_edge_viewer_response: strips and re-applies CSP on every response, arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789:function:security-headers-v3
config.api_gateway_request_validator: content-type must be application/json for POST
config.rls_tenant_isolation: prevents cross-tenant data access at DB layer
